newsitem.title: UK: Landround Plc issues prospectus for AIM float.
newsitem.headline: Landround Plc issues prospectus for AIM float.

text.p: Travel promotion supplier Landround Plc said on Tuesday it had released the prospectus for its flotation on the London Stock Exchange's Alternative Investment Market (AIM) in August.
The company said it had raised 365,000 stg before expenses via a placing at 80p per share and was capitalised at around 3.6 million stg.
Dealings were expected to start on August 13.

Landround, based in Chester, sells leisure break promotions supplied by groups such as P&O, Cunard and British Airways Holidays to companies which include British Telecommunications Plc, Coca-Cola Co and Dixons Plc.
The company said the float would increase the credibility of the company and allay any fears potential customers might have with its products.
Landround was founded in 1992 by its current management team and all employees are shareholders.
The company made pre-tax profits of 362,000 stg in the year to September 30 1996, up from 239,000 stg for the same period in 1995.
Henry Ansbacher & Co and W H Ireland Ltd are nominated advisers and brokers to Landround respectively.
